title: Lifting an action to a larger alphabet
statement: Let $e$ be an injection from the Boolean alphabet into an alphabet $\Gamma$, and let $a$ be a one-step action for a machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $S$. The corresponding action over $\Gamma$ keeps the input-head movement and successor state, maps each written symbol and output symbol through $e$ (preserving blanks and absent outputs), and keeps every work-head movement.
hypotheses_covered: An action with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $S$
